changelog:
Initial release of Agent Browser – a fast Rust-based headless browser automation CLI with structured commands.

- Enables AI agents (and users) to navigate, interact, fill forms, and extract data from web pages.
- Supports a wide range of commands for navigation, interaction, state checks, screenshots, video recording, cookies/storage, and network interception.
- Provides both element ref-based and semantic locators for flexible DOM automation.
- Offers quick install via npm with Node.js fallback; designed for CLI automation and scripting.
- Comprehensive documentation and interactive workflow examples included in SKILL.md.
